GOV-WORK-START-001.message: New work admission requires reconciliation of existing repository work or incomplete observations.
GOV-WORK-START-001.remediation: Run the managed work-start check; reuse the matching ticket, assist read-only, arrange a fenced handoff or serialize. Preserve unknown work; do not force allocation.

GOV-AGENT-HOST-001.message: Commit is not bound to an IN_PROGRESS ticket-NNN branch.
GOV-AGENT-HOST-001.remediation: Inspect existing branches and worktrees first; reuse the allocated ticket checkout. Allocate through ./project/new-ticket.sh only after work-start admission; never rename or discard unknown work to satisfy the hook.

GOV-AGENT-HOST-002.message: Staged snapshot has no ticket README for the branch ticket.
GOV-AGENT-HOST-002.remediation: Stage the allocated project/ticket-NNN/README.md; never invent a ticket number.

GOV-AGENT-HOST-003.message: A repository commit attempts to write terminal ticket closure state.
GOV-AGENT-HOST-003.remediation: Leave the reviewed repository payload unchanged and let the protected delivery controller emit the external merge or no-change receipt.

GOV-AGENT-HOST-004.message: A declared LLM host instruction file is missing or the host contract is unreadable.
GOV-AGENT-HOST-004.remediation: Bootstrap with ./scripts/install-agent-hosts.sh --source <hub> --target <repo>, or adopt the current standard package.

GOV-AGENT-HOST-005.message: The fail-closed pre-commit hook is missing or not executable.
GOV-AGENT-HOST-005.remediation: Restore .githooks/pre-commit through adoption and make it executable with chmod +x.

GOV-AGENT-HOST-006.message: core.hooksPath does not point at the managed hook directory.
GOV-AGENT-HOST-006.remediation: Activate the managed hook: git config core.hooksPath .githooks in this clone.

GOV-AGENT-HOST-007.message: A staged commit contains only ticket tracking carriers.
GOV-AGENT-HOST-007.remediation: Add the material deliverable, or emit an external no-change receipt and create no repository commit.

GOV-APPROVAL-001.message: Implementation lacks approval from a trusted external source.
GOV-APPROVAL-001.remediation: Observe the exact PR/head and existing review request; invoke the configured protected controller within existing publication authority, or route to the trusted reviewer. Read back its receipt before retry; green checks alone are not approval.

GOV-APPROVAL-002.message: Approval refers to a different ticket.
GOV-APPROVAL-002.remediation: Reconcile the current ticket and PR binding, then request protected review of that exact subject. Never edit old approval evidence to name another ticket.

GOV-APPROVAL-003.message: Approval evidence is missing, repository-controlled or structurally invalid.
GOV-APPROVAL-003.remediation: Create v1 approval evidence outside the PR checkout through a protected verifier.

GOV-APPROVAL-004.message: Approval evidence is bound to another repository, pull request or commit.
GOV-APPROVAL-004.remediation: Regenerate protected evidence for the exact repository, PR, HEAD and ticket tuple.

GOV-APPROVAL-005.message: Approval actor or verification method is not trusted for the claimed source.
GOV-APPROVAL-005.remediation: Use the type-specific protected allowlist or verify a signed attestation with a trusted issuer.

GOV-ARCHITECTURE-001.message: Architecture ownership, UI/data impact or component mapping is unresolved.
GOV-ARCHITECTURE-001.remediation: Classify actual data impact and resolve component or integration ownership under existing authority; follow the runbook before escalating.

GOV-BASE-001.message: The target branch or base SHA differs from the approved delivery contract.
GOV-BASE-001.remediation: Rebase or rebuild from the accepted base, then update intent only through an authorized scope review.

GOV-BASE-002.message: Target-branch advancement overlaps a component declared by the active ticket.
GOV-BASE-002.remediation: Refresh the branch, rerun validation and obtain fresh scope approval; do not repin for unrelated target changes.

GOV-BOOT-001.message: A required target-repository file is missing.
GOV-BOOT-001.remediation: Create the target-owned prerequisite or adopt the managed file through the pinned standard package as applicable.

GOV-BRANCH-LIFECYCLE-001.message: GitHub automatic head-branch deletion after merge is disabled.

GOV-BRANCH-LIFECYCLE-002.message: Remote branches exist without ownership by an open pull request.
GOV-BRANCH-LIFECYCLE-002.remediation: Observe the exact branch head and open/closed PR history; preserve unmerged work and reconcile its intent before choosing continued delivery or an explicitly authorized discard. Do not create an empty PR or delete a branch merely to satisfy this check.

GOV-BRANCH-LIFECYCLE-003.message: The branch lifecycle snapshot is missing, malformed or inconsistent.
GOV-BRANCH-LIFECYCLE-003.remediation: Re-acquire the snapshot from the protected GitHub workflow and reobserve inconsistent refs; preserve every branch while the observation is unresolved.

GOV-BUDGET-001.message: The actual implementation diff exceeds its approved budget.
GOV-BUDGET-001.remediation: Reduce the slice or obtain fresh authorization for a larger bounded intent.

GOV-CHANGE-LEASE-001.message: A change lease, transition request or receipt is malformed or not closed.
GOV-CHANGE-LEASE-001.remediation: Rebuild the document from the managed change-lease schema without undeclared fields.

GOV-CHANGE-LEASE-002.message: Change authority is stale or its receipt trace is not monotonic.
GOV-CHANGE-LEASE-002.remediation: Read the authoritative lease and retry with its exact revision, fencing token and phase.

GOV-CHANGE-LEASE-003.message: A change-lease transition violates the state machine or publication freeze.
GOV-CHANGE-LEASE-003.remediation: Keep the frozen HEAD immutable and request only a transition allowed from the current phase.

GOV-CHANGE-LEASE-004.message: Lease supersession lacks accepted terminal replacement evidence.
GOV-CHANGE-LEASE-004.remediation: Attach the exact accepted terminal receipt for the replacement lease before superseding.

GOV-CLASS-000.remediation: Restore the managed work-classification DSL from the pinned package before allocating a ticket.

GOV-CLASS-001.message: A requested work classification value is not declared.
GOV-CLASS-001.remediation: Choose kind, priority and origin values declared by the managed classification contract.

GOV-CONFLICT-001.message: Tickets declared as conflicting are active at the same time.
GOV-CONFLICT-001.remediation: Move one ticket to BACKLOG, PLAN or BLOCKED until the conflicting work reaches a terminal state.

GOV-CONTINUITY-001.message: A work-continuity checkpoint is malformed, unsafe or cannot preserve a dirty workspace.
GOV-CONTINUITY-001.remediation: Rebuild the bounded checkpoint from observable state; commit authorized work or provide a content-addressed, secret-scanned external snapshot.

GOV-CONTINUITY-002.message: The work-continuity receipt chain is stale, rebound or non-monotonic.
GOV-CONTINUITY-002.remediation: Recover the complete append-only chain from the protected receipt store and extend only its latest valid checkpoint.

GOV-CONTINUITY-003.message: A continuity checkpoint diverges from current repository observation.
GOV-CONTINUITY-003.remediation: Preserve both states and route to reconciliation or BLOCKED; do not reset, overwrite, restore or reuse a stale fencing token.

GOV-DECISION-001.message: A repository-changing autonomous decision lacks an append-only record or rewrites earlier evidence.
GOV-DECISION-001.remediation: Append a new recomputable decision record; never edit an earlier record.

GOV-DECISION-002.message: A decision record is not recomputable.
GOV-DECISION-002.remediation: Store deterministic inputs verbatim and name a replayable applied rule.

GOV-DECISION-003.message: A decision record treats advisory LLM output as verdict authority.
GOV-DECISION-003.remediation: Keep LLM output ADVISORY and derive the verdict from deterministic rules and evidence.

GOV-DECISION-004.message: Replaying decision inputs diverges from the recorded verdict.
GOV-DECISION-004.remediation: Correct the new decision record or underlying inputs; do not rewrite historical evidence.

GOV-DELIVERY-001.message: The implementation slice lacks or exceeds its approved delivery contract.
GOV-DELIVERY-001.remediation: Declare a valid bounded delivery block or split the work into a smaller authorized slice.

GOV-DELIVERY-002.message: The implementation slice reached its pre-stop checkpoint.
GOV-DELIVERY-002.remediation: Stop, record evidence and replan the remaining bounded work before continuing.

GOV-DEPENDENCY-001.message: The ticket dependency graph contains a cycle or self-reference.
GOV-DEPENDENCY-001.remediation: Rewrite dependsOn as an acyclic graph with no ticket depending on itself.

GOV-DEPENDENCY-002.message: An active ticket depends on a missing or unfinished ticket.
GOV-DEPENDENCY-002.remediation: Complete the dependency or move the dependent ticket out of IN_PROGRESS.

GOV-DIAGNOSTIC-001.message: The stable diagnostic catalog is malformed or differs from emitted runtime codes.
GOV-DIAGNOSTIC-001.remediation: Register every emitted code exactly once with a non-empty canonical message and remediation, and remove stale entries.

GOV-DIAGNOSTIC-002.message: A linked diagnostic runbook is missing, unsafe or structurally incomplete.
GOV-DIAGNOSTIC-002.remediation: Restore the linked error/*.md page with all required fail-closed sections and a relative path.

GOV-DIFF-001.message: The changed-path set or commit history could not be determined safely.
GOV-DIFF-001.remediation: Restore valid Git metadata and provide an explicit base and head before evaluating scope.

GOV-DOCKER-001.message: The required Docker runtime declaration is incomplete.
GOV-DOCKER-001.remediation: Declare the Docker marker and explicit governed Dockerfile/Compose paths, or truthfully disable the stack.

GOV-DOCKER-002.message: A Dockerfile or Compose image reference is not pinned to an immutable SHA-256 digest.
GOV-DOCKER-002.remediation: Replace every external image tag with registry/image@sha256 followed by 64 lowercase hex characters.

GOV-ENV-001.message: Governance environment resolution failed or exposed an undeclared value.
GOV-ENV-001.remediation: Use governance_env.py with declared variables, relative ENV_FILE paths and redacted required secrets.

GOV-INTEGRATION-001.message: A shared contract path lacks valid routing through an integration ticket.
GOV-INTEGRATION-001.remediation: Route the shared path through the manifest-declared integration workstream without transferring path ownership.

GOV-INTENT-001.message: Implementation changed before the ticket entered an implementation state.
GOV-INTENT-001.remediation: Record authorization and move the active ticket to EDIT, VALIDATION or PUBLICATION before changing implementation.

GOV-INTENT-002.message: Ticket intent is missing or malformed.
GOV-INTENT-002.remediation: Create a schema-valid intent.json with bounded allowedPaths and required delivery evidence.

GOV-INTENT-003.message: Ticket intent is absent from the first material implementation commit.
GOV-INTENT-003.remediation: Include the validated intent atomically with the first material change; do not manufacture a separate plan-only commit.

GOV-MANIFEST-001.message: Manifest or managed governance contract is missing, unreadable or structurally invalid.
GOV-MANIFEST-001.remediation: Restore the complete pinned governance package and validate its JSON contracts.

GOV-MATERIAL-001.message: The changeset contains only ticket tracking carriers and no material deliverable.
GOV-MATERIAL-001.remediation: Add a material source, test, configuration, standard or requested documentation change; if there is no delta, emit an external no-change receipt without a commit or PR.

GOV-OWNER-001.message: An untrusted actor changed a human-owned participant file.
GOV-OWNER-001.remediation: Revert the agent-authored human file change and obtain input from the human owner or trusted intake boundary.

GOV-PACKAGING-001.message: Package metadata declares no wellmanifest governance block.
GOV-PACKAGING-001.remediation: Declare the adopted standard version, revision and gate in pyproject.toml or package.json.

GOV-PACKAGING-002.message: Package governance declaration disagrees with the adoption lock.

GOV-PACKAGING-003.message: Packaging lifecycle does not run the governance gate.
GOV-PACKAGING-003.remediation: Bind the gate to scripts.prepare or the pytest addopts so the tooling runs it unprompted.

GOV-PATH-001.message: A committed governance artifact contains a machine-local absolute path.
GOV-PATH-001.remediation: Replace the local path with a repository-relative reference and sanitize committed logs.

GOV-PHYS-001.message: A changed path carries a declared physical contract but the intent declares no physical change for it.
GOV-PHYS-001.remediation: Declare every changed physical property with before, after and hardware acceptance checks, or property none with a rationale.

GOV-PHYS-002.message: The adopter's physical contract declaration is missing required fields or unreadable.
GOV-PHYS-002.remediation: Repair physical-contracts.json; the gate fails closed while it is invalid.

GOV-POLICY-DSL-001.message: CONTRIBUTING.md or its pinned Policy DSL runtime is invalid.
GOV-POLICY-DSL-001.remediation: Restore the managed Policy DSL files or correct the selected dsl fences, then rerun the governance gate.

GOV-PULL-REQUEST-STATE-001.message: The protected workflow cannot bind a live pull-request state to its event.
GOV-PULL-REQUEST-STATE-001.remediation: Re-acquire the pull request through the GitHub API and retry the workflow; do not skip open-PR ticket, scope or approval enforcement.

GOV-REMEDIATION-001.message: A diagnostic remediation intent is malformed, unresolved or semantically unsafe.
GOV-REMEDIATION-001.remediation: Correct the target-owned remediation-intent DSL and pass deterministic schema and semantic validation before LLM planning.

GOV-REMEDIATION-002.message: A todo2code plan conflicts with accepted remediation scope, criteria, priority or user-state safety.
GOV-REMEDIATION-002.remediation: Reject or regenerate the conflicting plan; obtain a fresh bounded intent before any material scope or authority expansion.

GOV-REMEDIATION-003.message: The todo2code advisory overlay is stale for the current remediation intent.
GOV-REMEDIATION-003.remediation: Discard the overlay and rerun deterministic todo2code analysis against the current authority-bearing intent digest.

GOV-REMEDIATION-004.message: A declared todo2code remediation projection is missing, stale or outside the selected repository root.
GOV-REMEDIATION-004.remediation: Render both declared projections atomically from the accepted intent, verify their exact bytes, then rerun todo2code extraction.

GOV-SCOPE-001.message: A changed implementation path is outside approved intent scope.
GOV-SCOPE-001.remediation: Remove the unrelated change or obtain a fresh bounded intent before editing that path.

GOV-SECRET-001.message: A changed file contains a probable secret assignment.
GOV-SECRET-001.remediation: Stop publication, remove and rotate the secret through a trusted boundary, then rescan the exact diff.

GOV-STACK-001.message: The declared technology stack lacks its required project marker.
GOV-STACK-001.remediation: Add a truthful root marker or remove the incorrect stack declaration; do not create a synthetic marker only to pass the gate.

GOV-STATUS-001.message: A ticket status is missing or not declared by the governance manifest.
GOV-STATUS-001.remediation: Use one declared active, non-active or closed status and a compatible workflow state.

GOV-STANDARD-UPDATE-001.message: The pinned Wellmanifest standard cannot be verified or safely prepared during pre-commit.
GOV-STANDARD-UPDATE-001.remediation: Install a compatible Goal release and use one active standard-adoption ticket to prepare, review and restage the immutable update.

GOV-STANDARD-PACK-001.message: The repository does not satisfy the standard-pack baseline selected by its governance profile.
GOV-STANDARD-PACK-001.remediation: Adopt every pack required by the selected profile at or above its minimum level, then rerun standard_pack_check.py --strict.

GOV-SYNC-001.message: A managed governance file does not match its pinned SHA-256 digest.
GOV-SYNC-001.remediation: Adopt or upgrade the complete immutable package through Goal; do not patch managed payload files manually.

GOV-TICKET-001.message: Implementation changed without exactly one active ticket.
GOV-TICKET-001.remediation: Keep the owning ticket IN_PROGRESS through implementation publication; after merge, let the protected controller emit the external terminal receipt without a repository closure commit.

GOV-TICKET-EXTERNAL-001.message: The selected external ticket backend has no valid active local adapter.
GOV-TICKET-EXTERNAL-001.remediation: Refresh the repository-local adapter from the external ticket system and keep its bounded scope, state and source evidence consistent.

GOV-TICKET-ACTIVITY-001.message: Ticket activity cannot be resolved safely from the managed policy and clone-external terminal receipt registry.
GOV-TICKET-ACTIVITY-001.remediation: Keep the status projection active, then reconcile or recover the clone-external registry from protected evidence.

GOV-TICKET-002.message: More than one active ticket exists where the manifest permits only one.
GOV-TICKET-002.remediation: Continue the matching ticket and move unrelated waiting work to BACKLOG, PLAN or BLOCKED.

GOV-TICKET-003.message: An active ticket is malformed or missing a required governance file.
GOV-TICKET-003.remediation: Restore its README, preprompt, changelog, intent and typed agent participant files before implementation.

GOV-TICKET-004.message: Executable source, test or research content is stored in a ticket directory.
GOV-TICKET-004.remediation: Move executable material to its normal source, scripts or tests directory and keep only evidence in the ticket.

GOV-TICKET-005.message: Implementation paths do not resolve to exactly one active ticket.
GOV-TICKET-005.remediation: Split unrelated paths or correct non-overlapping allowedPaths and workstream ownership.

GOV-TICKET-ALLOCATION-001.message: A ticket claim is outside a valid clone-wide high-water reservation.
GOV-TICKET-ALLOCATION-001.remediation: Preserve the worktree, classify ownership and allocate a fresh ID only through project/new-ticket.sh.

GOV-TICKET-ALLOCATION-002.message: Linked worktrees assign different intents to the same ticket ID.
GOV-TICKET-ALLOCATION-002.remediation: Stop both writers, preserve both heads and reallocate the later intent through project/new-ticket.sh before rebuilding its branch.

GOV-TICKET-ALLOCATION-003.message: A distributed writer lacks a valid receipt from the registered atomic ticket allocator.
GOV-TICKET-ALLOCATION-003.remediation: Submit the emitted exact request to the configured process URI and retry with its fresh fenced receipt; never choose a local number.

GOV-TICKET-ALLOCATION-004.message: A registered allocation resolves to a ticket identity already visible in repository state.
GOV-TICKET-ALLOCATION-004.remediation: Continue the existing claim or request a fresh fenced allocation after reconciliation; do not recreate, rename or overwrite it.

GOV-TICKET-LOCK-001.message: Another ticket allocation holds the clone-wide lock.
GOV-TICKET-LOCK-001.remediation: Wait for the allocator; remove a stale lock only after proving no allocation process is active.

GOV-TICKET-LOCK-002.message: The clone-wide ticket high-water state is invalid.
GOV-TICKET-LOCK-002.remediation: Preserve ticket worktrees and repair the shared numeric reservation before assigning another ID.

GOV-TICKET-LOCK-003.message: The ticket directory selected by the allocator already exists.
GOV-TICKET-LOCK-003.remediation: Stop and classify the existing claim; never overwrite or rename it automatically.

GOV-TICKET-LOCK-004.message: Remote ticket refs could not be refreshed before allocation.
GOV-TICKET-LOCK-004.remediation: Restore origin connectivity and retry; do not allocate from stale refs.

GOV-WORKSPACE-LIFECYCLE-001.message: A terminal workspace still contains a linked worktree.
GOV-WORKSPACE-LIFECYCLE-001.remediation: Verify dirty state and HEAD reachability, then remove only the exact disposable worktree through Git.

GOV-WORKSPACE-LIFECYCLE-002.message: A terminal workspace still contains a duplicate clone.
GOV-WORKSPACE-LIFECYCLE-002.remediation: Verify it has no unique data, then move the exact duplicate checkout to recoverable trash.

GOV-WORKSPACE-LIFECYCLE-003.message: The local workspace audit could not be completed safely.
GOV-WORKSPACE-LIFECYCLE-003.remediation: Repair repository metadata or narrow the explicit workspace root before cleanup.

GOV-WORKSPACE-LIFECYCLE-004.message: A terminal workspace still contains a non-default local branch.
GOV-WORKSPACE-LIFECYCLE-004.remediation: Classify its HEAD, preserve unique history, release any worktree and delete only the exact disposable local ref.

GOV-WORKSTREAM-001.message: An active ticket declares a missing or unknown workstream.
GOV-WORKSTREAM-001.remediation: Choose a workstream declared by the current governance manifest.

GOV-WORKSTREAM-002.message: A workstream exceeds its active-ticket limit.
GOV-WORKSTREAM-002.remediation: Keep one implementation owner active and release waiting reservations.

GOV-WORKSTREAM-003.message: A changed path is not owned by the ticket workstream.
GOV-WORKSTREAM-003.remediation: Move the path to the owning workstream or correct the manifest through an authorized integration change.

GOV-WORKSTREAM-004.message: Active ticket write scopes overlap on a concrete repository path.
GOV-WORKSTREAM-004.remediation: Serialize the work or narrow allowedPaths until each changed path has exactly one owner.

GOV-WORKTREE-OVERLAP-001.message: Two worktrees of the same repository are changing the same paths.
GOV-WORKTREE-OVERLAP-001.remediation: Stop one writer, declare conflictsWith, or move the overlapping paths to a single ticket / integration workstream before merge.

GOV-WORKTREE-OVERLAP-002.message: IN_PROGRESS tickets in sibling worktrees claim overlapping allowedPaths without conflictsWith.
GOV-WORKTREE-OVERLAP-002.remediation: Add conflictsWith on both intents, serialize one ticket to BACKLOG/PLAN/BLOCKED, or narrow allowedPaths so they no longer overlap.

GOV-WORKTREE-OVERLAP-003.message: The worktree overlap audit could not be completed safely.
GOV-WORKTREE-OVERLAP-003.remediation: Repair repository metadata or narrow the explicit workspace root before relying on the guard.

GOV-BRANCH-INTENT-001.message: Branch intent reconciliation is incomplete, stale or invalid.
GOV-BRANCH-INTENT-001.remediation: Preserve history, reacquire the complete accepted criterion inventory and independently verified receipts at the exact source/target SHA; retain unknown work for review. Report conformance never authorizes deletion.

GOV-SNAPSHOT-MIGRATION-001.message: The snapshot migration contract is invalid.
GOV-SNAPSHOT-MIGRATION-001.remediation: Preserve the source; reobserve the exact subject and protected grant before a bounded successor action.

GOV-SNAPSHOT-MIGRATION-002.message: The immutable migration subject or complete Git history is unavailable.
GOV-SNAPSHOT-MIGRATION-002.remediation: Preserve the source; reobserve the exact subject and protected grant before a bounded successor action.

GOV-SNAPSHOT-MIGRATION-003.message: The migration authorization is missing or differs from the protected subject.
GOV-SNAPSHOT-MIGRATION-003.remediation: Preserve the source; reobserve the exact subject and protected grant before a bounded successor action.

GOV-SNAPSHOT-MIGRATION-004.message: The migration does not preserve source ancestry and atomic new intent.
GOV-SNAPSHOT-MIGRATION-004.remediation: Preserve the source; reobserve the exact subject and protected grant before a bounded successor action.

GOV-SNAPSHOT-MIGRATION-005.message: The migration inventory or imported tree differs from its authorized snapshot.
GOV-SNAPSHOT-MIGRATION-005.remediation: Preserve the source; reobserve the exact subject and protected grant before a bounded successor action.

GOV-SNAPSHOT-MIGRATION-006.message: The migration authorization was consumed or its one-use base or ticket changed.
GOV-SNAPSHOT-MIGRATION-006.remediation: Preserve the source; reobserve the exact subject and protected grant before a bounded successor action.

GOV-VERSION-001.message: Declared package version does not match root VERSION specification.
GOV-VERSION-001.remediation: Synchronize package manifests (pyproject.toml, setup.py, package.json, Cargo.toml) and code declarations with the authoritative VERSION file.
